details: package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, unzips it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle at the tarball root (string-array rotator, hex-named identifiers, large index table — obfuscator.io shape), is not referenced by the plugin's `main`, and has no source or build declaration. The advertised purpose is an ESLint plugin for neverthrow, which has no need for a second language runtime or an opaque bundled payload. The alternate-runtime choice specifically evades Node-based analysis by executing the payload under Bun instead of Node. Additional inconsistency: package version is 1.3.3 while setup.mjs hardcodes a Bun release tag as `1.3.13`, consistent with a hijacked or typosquatted release rather than a legitimate build helper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
